_doc: Structured requirements manifest (Sprint V15). Operator-provided fields are marked source=operator ; fields measured on the reference by the tools are in reference_measures.json. Reusable for other maps : replace the subject, reference, prototypes and regions.

request.text_fr: Carte LEGO de Hyrule immédiatement reconnaissable, esthétiquement convaincante et constructible, inspirée d'une carte topographique miniature ; cadre en bois et texture LEGO conservés ; titre discret ; référence de qualité visuelle : le modèle LEGO de Hyrule fourni.

subject.name: Hyrule

version.evidence: the title plate of the reference picture reads 'THE LEGEND OF ZELDA BREATH OF THE WILD' ; the layout (snow mountains NW, desert SW, volcano with crater NE, central plain with castle moat, sea to the east) is that of the BotW map
version.source: operator visual reading of the picture (NOT automatic OCR)

subject.rule: only the BotW geography seen in the reference is reproduced ; no element of another game is added ; if the version were unclear the routing returns needs_input

reference.kind: top-down picture of a third-party LEGO model of the BotW map
reference.rights: unknown (third-party model) : kept out of Git, used as private reference ; only derived class grids and measures are versioned
reference.map_rect_note: interior of the map plate measured on the picture (frame, bottom title plate and outer border excluded)

board.aspect_source: measured on the picture (1128 x 916 px) ; V14 assumed a square 80 x 80 grid, which distorts the geography
board.frame: dark brown wood-like frame with gold corners, kept from the current style, secondary to the map
board.title: none on the map (a separate plate or the frame is future work) ; recognition must not need the title

class_meaning.void: off-map dark plate (west and north edge)
class_meaning.shore: darker sand / coast and plateau edges
class_meaning._hi: same family at altitude (variants used by the hybrid pipeline for tonal progression)

reference_prototypes._doc: Lab prototypes (k-means, k=16, seed 1, on the smoothed reference) named by the operator ; classification = nearest prototype
reference_prototypes.source: operator naming of automatically computed clusters

regions_to_preserve.name_interpretation: central plain with the castle moat
open sea along the east and south-east coast
large lake south of the centre (probably Lake Hylia : to confirm)

landmarks_manual_measured_on_reference.note: ring of water around the castle, centre-north
dark enclosed crater in the brown massif
spiral sand formation on the east coast
large blue lake south of the centre

relief.principle: progressive relief from semantic zones : mountains (snow, stone, mesa, rust) rise with the distance to their edge, plains and deserts stay low, water lowest, crater depressed ; NOT a colour-to-height lookup of the picture
relief.source_of_heights: none available : relief is ESTIMATED from the zones (the picture is a top view without altitude data) and declared as such

palette.intent: natural, harmonious, deep blue sea, lighter teal lakes, two greens, white/grey mountains, tan desert, tan-brown and red-brown highlands ; brown must not dominate

lego_constraints.validation: independent validator : 0 collision, 0 disconnected, 0 island, 0 unsupported
lego_constraints.catalogue: real parts only, colours available in >= 8 sets, 0 substitution
lego_constraints.size_note: board size follows the grid ; printable-module export (V13) remains possible

artistic_priorities: water bodies consistent with the reference
recognition_criteria: pixel_accuracy >= 0.55 vs the reference class map
all priority-1 regions present at their reference position
detail_level: standard 96 x 78 studs (comparable piece count to V14) ; fine 128 x 104 studs for the hybrid variant
known_limits: the reference shows hundreds of 1x1 details (trees, flowers, towers) that a 96 x 78 raster cannot carry
no altitude data : relief is a documented estimate
